name: Sweet Calendar
source:
Today’s your girlfriend’s birthday, and you forgot to check the calendar. But she’s such a sweet girl – she won’t get mad, right?

[From [url=https://ai-erita.itch.io/sweet-calendar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是女朋友的生日，而你忘了看日曆。可她是那麼甜美可愛的姑娘，應該不會生氣，對吧？

［摘自[url=https://ai-erita.itch.io/sweet-calendar]Itch.io[/url]］
